To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The administration of ICI 184780 at 08: 00 h on proestrous day produced a 14% inhibition of lumina epithelial cell proliferation and a 21% reduction of uterine wet weights, as compared to controls, and 2) the administration of Ici 184780 at the time of ovulation (00:00 h estrus day) had no effect on cell proliferation or uterine wet wt, and 3) The

ICI 182780 (ICI) treatment induced a marked nuclear localization of the GSK-3β/AKT signaling pathway and cyclin D1 in the uterus of rats during the estrous cycles, but the administration period of ICI was crucial for this effect.

ICI 182780, an antiestrogen, has agonist activity on the uterine cell cycle progression, and that the mechanism of action of this agonist activity depends on the time of administration during the estrous cycles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the mechanisms involved in the regulation of cell proliferation in the rat uterus and the role of the Akt/GSK3-β pathway during the estrous cycles.
the regulation of the GSK3/Akt pathway during the estrous cycles in the rat uterus.
the regulation of uterine cell growth during the estrous cycles in intact rats, and the possible role of ICI as an estrogen agonist in the uterus of these animals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, in the uterus of intact rats, ICI administration at 08: 00 h on proestrous day causes an inhibition of uterine cell growth, whereas administration of the same dose of ICI at estrus day does not cause any effect.

, in the rat uterus, the administration of IICI during the proestrus day, but not during the estrus day, causes a decrease in uterine cell proliferative activity, which is accompanied by the inhibition of the Akt pathway.
the ICI 182780 is a selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) and not a pure antagonist.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the administration of the pure estrogen antagonist ICI, during the proestrus phase of the estrous, causes an agonistic effect on cell proliferation through GSK3-β/AKT pathway, whereas, during the estrus phase of the cycle, ICI exerts a negative effect on cell proliferation.

the ICI treatment at proestrus day induces a reduction of uterine cell proliferative activity through the inhibition of the GSK 3 β/Akt pathway, whereas ICI administration at the estrus day does not affect uterine cell growth, probably due to an increase of GSK 2 β/Akt activity.
the anti-estrogen ICI 182780 has a dual role, depending on the administration time during the estrous.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the administration of the antiestrogen ICI 182780 during the proestrus day induces an inhibition of luminal cell proliferation, and this effect is associated with a reduction in the uterine wet-weight, and a decrease in Akt phosphorylation at serine 473.
ICI 182780 has agonistic activity in the rat uterus, and that it can block cell proliferation via protein kinases B/Akt pathway, depending on the period of the estrous when the drug is administered.

the mechanism of action of ICI 184,780 is not only an ERα antagonist but it may also act as an agonist, and that the mechanism of uterine cell growth during the estrous is different than in the oophorectomized rat model.
